settings.heading: One theme. A different kind of store.
settings.subheading: Northstar Systems demonstrates Quadratum through workload discovery, product specifications, editorial guides and connected support.
settings.image_alt: Northstar system hardware with restrained Polaris lighting

settings.title: The design is Northstar. The building blocks are Quadratum.
settings.body: This demo uses native theme sections and reusable blocks. Its menus, product content, collection routes and editorial pages work together as a complete storefront.

settings.heading: Explore the experience.
settings.subheading: Four paths through the capabilities used in this demo.

settings.title: Workload discovery
settings.body: Collection cards guide visitors by Create, Compile, Render and Play. Comparison tables make the system differences explicit.

settings.title: Product understanding
settings.body: Native product galleries, specification panels, compatibility tabs and FAQs connect product details to buying decisions.

settings.title: Editorial storytelling
settings.body: Split banners, article spotlights and native blog templates turn product research into a guided experience.

settings.title: Connected support
settings.body: Topic tabs become mobile accordions. Deep links open the right answer, and the native contact form handles the next step.
